title: Cosmic Oracle Tree
description: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a central metallic tree-like sculpture with a large all-seeing eye and glowing orb containing a brain and rose. Three winged female faces float in the purple aurora sky above jagged mountains. A multicolored serpent coils around the tree while another emerges from a bowl of flowers. Lightning and dripping paint effects are visible throughout.
prompt: surreal fantasy scene with a dark metallic tree sculpture topped with a large realistic eye and a glowing glass orb containing a brain and pink rose, multicolored snake coiled around the tree, bowl of pink roses and grapes with another snake emerging, three floating angelic female faces with blue jeweled headdresses in the sky, dramatic purple aurora borealis swirling overhead, full moon, jagged dark mountains in background, paint dripping from concrete ledge, lightning effects, mystical atmosphere
